Preparing workspaces…

The shared input assumes headerless 640×512 uint16, little-endian, lower 14 bits; matching file length does not prove format. 200 MiB cap in this combined view. File is read locally. Both workspaces must report loaded before the shared frame control is enabled. Their individual controls can change state independently; synthetic scenes differ between apps. The preview resets Argos state on file changes and non-consecutive seeks, which also resets Argos settings on file load. Start paused and expect high CPU/memory use, especially at full resolution. In the viewer sandbox, downloads and model persistence may not work; open the downloaded HTML in a normal browser if needed.
